text_block_list.text: Time has flown by since launching our plan to make Locodol Hokko Tarumae's solo event a success, and before we knew it, the Junior Class was drawing to a close—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Music, cue!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Alright.
Let's check it right away!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
......Yeah, this looks promising.
The lighting is great,
and the location really shines!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Let's go with this for today's UmaTok. Now, next up is—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Hello Tomakomai, everyone~♪
I'm Hokko Tarumae, Tomakomai's local idol
who loves surf clams☆♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Today is a special project!
It's a Tarumae Cooking livestream, ya know!
I hope ya'll watch over me and see if I do alright♪"

text_block_list.name: Live Chat
text_block_list.text:
"G'day-komai~" "Looking cute today too~!"
"Good luck cooking!" "Rare to see you in uniform~"
"Don't get hurt!" "Dabe dabe~"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the support, everyone! Well then,
let's get right into today's theme, making "Surf Clam Curry"!
First off—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
“—Today's UmaTube livestream hit an all-time high for concurrent viewers and likes...!
Even on UmaTok, the 'Uma-like' rate is doing amazingly well!”
choice_data_list: Your followers and subscribers have really gone up, huh

text_block_list.text: ...To expand her local idol activities and raise her profile, Hokko Tarumae actively posted on social media in between her training sessions.

The efforts to fully utilize Umatter, Umastagram, UmaTube,
UmaTok, and the like were slowly but surely bearing fruit—

Compared to right after her debut, it feels like
she's gained a steady, dedicated following.
Yet, her efforts don't stop there.
—She has been pouring all her efforts into honing her craft as a dirt Umamusume, steadily building the foundation needed to take on the grand stage.

"Wearing two pairs of shoes takes an enormous
amount of effort. Yet Hokko Tarumae continues
to walk this path with earnest, steady determination."
The days leading up to today once again made me realize that this earnest attitude is Hokko Tarumae's greatest weapon—

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“—And so begins YumeUma TV!
This week, we've got an in-depth breakdown of the year-end dirt races!”

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's starting!
The special feature on this year's dirt races.
After reflecting on today's training and local idol activities, I had promised to watch this TV program together with Hokko Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
—The grand finale of the dirt season, the Tokyo Daishoten,
is right around the corner this year as well,
and this Umamusume is definitely the one to watch!

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: Riding an unbroken winning streak with her overwhelming running, the Umadol reigning as the absolute Monarch of the Dirt! Smart Falcon!!

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
Her victory in last year's Tokyo Daishoten
set an astonishing new record time!
Man, that run was truly unbelievable, wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
Will Smart Falcon achieve back-to-back victories!
Or will another Umamusume stop her in her tracks!
Regarded as a battle that will shape the future of the dirt racing world—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Last year's Tokyo Daishoten.
Falco-san was truly amazing.
Rickey and I were watching right there in the stands—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Smart Falcon,
pulling way ahead of the pack to take the lead!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"In the lead is number 13!! Smart Falcon!!
Across the finish line!!"
(WOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(...I can't breathe. My body is trembling.
So that's... Falco-san's running. That's――)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: The radiance... of the pinnacle...—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...I was overwhelmed.
And... I was also captivated."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I want to become a dirt Umamusume like Falco-san.
If I do, I'm sure I can turn everyone's eyes
towards Tomakomai—
choice_data_list: I'm sure you can become one.

text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae's strengths truly make me believe
from the bottom of my heart: she will definitely become
an Umamusume who contends for the pinnacle of dirt.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
......Trainer-san, don't you sometimes
just say things purely on reflex
without thinking at all?
choice_data_list: What!? That's not true at all!
What!? That's not true at all!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—sorry, just kidding.
You answered so instantly, Trainer,
that I couldn't help teasing you a bit.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Right! Now that we've seen what we wanted to see,
let's wrap things up for today!
I'll be counting on you again tomorrow!"
One day, while Hokko Tarumae was doing independent training—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
Isn't that over there—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Yep, it's definitely Acute-san.
Though her vibe is kinda...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: —Hup!!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: âHooooooo-ryaaaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Incredible! Her fierce spirit reaches all the way over here!
I've never seen Acute-san like this—)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...No, you're wrong.
It's just that I've finally... come to understand.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(It's because of all the actual dirt race experience I gained in the Junior Class
that I can now sense it.
Just how incredible Acute-san's running really is—)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
......You told me I could become one, Trainer-san.
Even so, but still, can I really――

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (Will I ever be able to compete... with running that sharp and powerful...?)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
“—I see! The swell from the west that was indicated was actually Acute-san!
Fufu, looks like this will have a great influence on me♪”

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Rickey...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san's late-charge training with a big race coming up
is more than worth seeing in person! Oh, don't tell me
you're here to get your spirit dialed in too, Tarumae?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
N-No, that's not it...! Feng shui has nothing to do with this!
I just happened to come here for some solo training!
Besides—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Full of energy...? In fact,
it's quite the opposite—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Is that so? Acute-san has great synergy with Tarumae, so I figured she'd be a much better influence than me~.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Rickey can only stay that carefree
because she doesn't fully understand
how amazing Acute-san truly is.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, harsher than usual! But well,
Tarumae's ahead of pre-debut me, so there's
probably stuff only she can understand.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: But you know, just because I realized how amazing Acute-san is—that's no reason for me to stop running, right?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I have a dream I want to fulfill!
To dominate my races, spread the power of feng shui, and make everyone happy!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Still, I know that countless walls will appear before that dream.
From my perspective, Tarumae is one of those big walls, after all.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it's up to me to decide my own path.
In the end, I'm the one who applies the principles of feng shui.
And I'm the one who decides whether to give up when facing a wall.”

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Just as reason alone does not forge a path,
the mere presence of a wall does not block one.
What matters is how I choose to face the phenomenon.☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: A way of being... in the face of the phenomenon—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's why, no matter how incredible Acute-san or Tarumae are,
it's no reason for me to give up on my dream♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "Here's a suggestion! To help a sensitive Tarumae become more positive, how about finally learning some feng shui—"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hey!
You always end up steering things in that direction!!
Didn't I tell you I don't believe in Feng Shui?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Hmm, no good, huh~☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Honestly, geez...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(...Still, Rickey's attitude is something to learn from.
Faced with firsthand reality, whether to give up on my dream or not is entirely up to me—)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(“You can definitely do it.”
Believing in those earnest words, running forward,
and making it a reality—that choice is mine to make!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
......Well, thanks anyway, Rickey.
I think I feel... just a little bit better.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? A sudden recovery!
Did you finally feel the power of feng shui?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I'm not feeling anything!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(—I need to pull myself together.
To charge forward toward my dream without fear...!)
